metadata.name: PhotoAlbum-Java
metadata.description: A simple photo storage and gallery application built with Spring Boot and Oracle DB

application.name: PhotoAlbum-Java
application.description: A simple photo storage and gallery application built with Spring Boot and Oracle DB

issues.title: Oracle Database Dependency
issues.description: Application uses Oracle Database which may not be available or cost-effective in cloud environments. Consider migrating to cloud-native database services.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Azure SQL Database, PostgreSQL, or MySQL. Update JDBC driver and connection strings accordingly.
migrationPath: Choose cloud-native database (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
Migrate data using Azure Database Migration Service

issues.title: Database BLOB Storage for Images
issues.description: Application stores photo files as BLOBs in the database. This approach doesn't scale well in cloud environments and increases database costs.
issues.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Blob Storage or Azure Files for photo storage. Store only metadata and file references in the database.
migrationPath: Update Photo model to store file URLs instead of BLOBs
Modify upload logic to save files to Azure Blob Storage
Update retrieval logic to fetch from Azure Blob Storage
Migrate existing photos from database to cloud storage

issues.title: Hardcoded Database Credentials
issues.description: Database credentials are hardcoded in application.properties file. This is a security risk in cloud deployments.
issues.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault or environment variables for sensitive configuration. Implement Azure Managed Identity for passwordless authentication.
migrationPath: Add Azure Key Vault dependency to pom.xml
Configure application to read from Key Vault
Store database credentials in Key Vault
Enable Managed Identity for Azure resources
Remove hardcoded credentials from properties files

issues.title: Outdated Java Version
issues.description: Application uses Java 8 which is outdated. Modern cloud platforms support and optimize for Java 11, 17, or 21 (LTS versions).
issues.recommendation: Upgrade to Java 17 or Java 21 (latest LTS) for better performance, security updates, and cloud compatibility.
migrationPath: Update pom.xml to target Java 17 or 21
Update Dockerfile to use Java 17/21 base image

issues.title: DDL Auto Create Mode
issues.description: JPA is configured with 'create' ddl-auto mode which drops and recreates schema on every startup. This will cause data loss in production.
issues.recommendation: Change ddl-auto to 'validate' or 'none' for production. Use database migration tools like Flyway or Liquibase.
migrationPath: Configure migration tool in application properties

issues.title: Container Optimization Needed
issues.description: Dockerfile exists but may not be optimized for cloud deployment with multi-stage builds and minimal base images.
issues.recommendation: Use multi-stage Docker builds with minimal base images (Alpine or Distroless). Implement health checks and optimize layers.

issues.title: Limited Observability
issues.description: Application lacks integration with cloud monitoring and logging services. No Application Insights or distributed tracing.
issues.recommendation: Add Azure Application Insights for monitoring, logging, and distributed tracing. Configure proper log aggregation.
migrationPath: Set up alerts and dashboards in Azure Portal

issues.title: Stateful File Upload
issues.description: File upload uses in-memory processing which may cause issues under high load or in scaled-out deployments.
issues.recommendation: Implement chunked file upload with progress tracking. Consider async processing for large files.
migrationPath: Consider Azure Service Bus for async processing

containerization.notes: Docker support exists. Needs optimization for cloud deployment.

configuration.notes: Hardcoded credentials present. Needs externalized configuration.

database.notes: Uses Oracle DB. Migration to cloud-native database recommended.

storage.notes: Uses database BLOBs. Cloud object storage recommended.

monitoring.notes: Basic logging present. Cloud monitoring integration needed.

scalability.notes: Stateless design mostly. File upload needs improvement.

security.notes: Basic validation present. Credential management needs improvement.

immediate: Remove hardcoded credentials and use Azure Key Vault
Change JPA ddl-auto mode to 'validate' or 'none'
Migrate from database BLOB storage to Azure Blob Storage
shortTerm: Migrate from Oracle to Azure SQL Database or PostgreSQL
Add Azure Application Insights for monitoring
longTerm: Add distributed caching (Azure Cache for Redis)
Implement API rate limiting and throttling

Implement Azure Blob Storage for photos
